# Justin Dao resume and portfolio

This folder is the working Git checkout for the live portfolio. Start with AGENTS.md. Portfolio_Requirements.md and Resume_Requirements.md hold the scoped rules; references preserves both supplied briefs. The project skill is .agents/skills/justin-career/SKILL.md.

Preview: `python -m http.server 8000 --bind 127.0.0.1`, then open http://127.0.0.1:8000/?theme=light#work. Stop with Ctrl+C.

Check assets: `python tools/check_site.py`. No build or dependency install is required.

Pages: index.html, instacart.html, tstar.html and legacy places.html. Current Places view is on the home page. Vale and TMA use panels. Current resume: Justin-Dao-Resume.pdf.

Review Git diffs before publication. Keep guidance and personal source material out of public deployment commits. Career/Portfolio remains the imported source; edits here do not automatically update it.
